name: Hindustan Unilever Limited
remarksWeb: As intimated to the Stock Exchanges vide our Letters dated 27th June, 2022 and 4th July, 2022 the names of three of our promoter entities Brooke Bond Group Limited, Brooke Bond Assam Estates Limited and Brooke Bond South India Estates Limited have changed to Unilever Group Limited, Unilever Assam Estates Limited and Unilever South India Estates Limited, respectively. However, the updation of PAN records pursuant to the name change is still in process.
